authorization: On October 13, 2026 the owner asked to “fix the 1º date and the titles too” after F-88 left the pt-BR first of the month open. Asked “Do you approve a one-time Phase 1 scope allowance for exactly one protected file, src/lib/i18n/dates.ts, so that every Portuguese date writes the first of the month as “1º” (“1º de novembro de 2026”)? The tab-title fix needs no protected files.”, the owner chose “Approve allowance (Recommended)” on October 13, 2026. This one-time exact-path allowance covers only src/lib/i18n/dates.ts: formatDate and formatDateTime write day 1 as “1º” in Portuguese dates that name the month (“1º de novembro de 2026”, “1º de nov. de 2026”), as the review of F-88 asked and the review of this change confirmed. Numeric dates, days 11, 21 and 31, and every other language are unchanged.
